system.name: GraphMaster
system.one_liner: Hierarchical multi-agent framework, framed as retrieval-augmented generation, in which four LLM-powered agents iteratively extend a small text-attributed graph with generated nodes and edges.

content.variant_note: four colour-coded agent regions arranged as a clockwise loop around a manager, each with its own small chain of steps and artifacts
content.argues: Four specialised LLM agents (manager, perception, enhancement, evaluation) in a recursive loop can synthesise semantically rich and structurally coherent graph extensions, with the manager steering until convergence.
content.subject: Roles, steps and hand-offs of the four agents of GraphMaster, from query to extracted knowledge, new nodes and edges, reserved nodes and a status report.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each agent its own colour and a robot head, and carry that colour through its dashed region, the arrows inside it and the artifacts it produces, so a multi-agent loop can be read by colour; use pale thick arrows for hand-offs between agents.
lessons.suits: Multi-agent frameworks with a few specialised roles in a loop, each with internal steps and typed artifacts such as queries, reports, knowledge and candidates.

evidence: GraphMaster: A hierarchical multi-agent framework for text-attributed graph synthesis.
four specialized LLM-powered agents operate collaboratively in a recursive optimization loop

summary: GraphMaster is a hierarchical multi-agent framework, framed as retrieval-augmented generation, that synthesises text-attributed graphs when real data are scarce. Figure 1 draws four dash-dot, colour-coded regions, each headed by a robot icon: a pink Manager that initialises the other agents, updates weights and chooses a semantic or topological mode; a blue Perception agent that identifies communities, samples a core subgraph and writes an environmental report as extracted knowledge; a green Enhancement agent that generates tokens, new nodes and edges; and a yellow Evaluation agent that filters nodes by quality and synthesises the reserved nodes into the graph, whose status report returns to the manager for the convergence check. Equations sit beside four of the steps.
summary_zh: GraphMaster 是面向文本属性图合成的层级多智能体框架。图1用四个彩色虚线区域，各配机器人：粉色管理者选模式并判断收敛，蓝色感知者采样子图，绿色增强者生成节点与边，黄色评估者筛选节点并入图。
notes: Roles come from the labels and the paper sentence; a few hand-off arrows are read from the picture only, notably the Merged report arrow beside the blue robot in the evaluation region and the yellow arrow from the large graph into the status report. The caption is a one-line title.
